title: Wuoshi (Seasonal)
summary: Respond to Wuoshi's eight-second warnings and break the grove's protective and healing bonds.
overview: Respond to Wuoshi's eight-second warnings and break the grove's protective and healing bonds.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Follow the ground mark for spores and the moving player mark for flare.
Switch immediately to vines, barrier guardians and the heartbloom when required.

phases.label: Grove mechanics
phases.description: Cycle through fixed spores, a breakable vine prison and a moving flare mark.

phases.label: Flora Barrier
phases.description: Kill every guardian within seventy-five seconds to avoid a heal.

phases.label: Heartbloom
phases.description: Destroy the healing bloom while continuing movement responses.

phases.label: Tunare's wrath
phases.description: Survive faster, stronger mechanics through the finish.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Toxic spores mark Wuoshi's current location: move beyond seventy feet of that fixed point before they burst.
Destroy the strangling vine to free its marked prisoner. Solar Flare follows its marked player, who must separate at least twenty-eight feet from allies.
At 75%, Wuoshi becomes protected and summons scaled guardians. Clear them within seventy-five seconds; failure restores eight percent of her health before the barrier falls.
At 45%, destroy the heartbloom that restores one percent of Wuoshi's health every eight seconds.
At 20%, warnings retain their eight-second duration but recovery gaps shorten and mechanic damage increases. A wipe clears adds and roots and restores the boss.
